rule: Salt-bloom is harvested at new moon
texts: When a Keeper harvests salt-bloom at the new moon, that salt-bloom keeps its potency.
Whenever a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the new moon, that salt-bloom stays potent.
When a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the full moon, that salt-bloom turns to chalky residue.
When a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the half moon, that salt-bloom turns to chalky residue.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper harvests salt-bloom at the new moon, that salt-bloom keeps its potency.
parse: (: rule_saltbloom_potency (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $h harvest) (Agent $h $k) (Theme $h $sb) (Member $sb salt_bloom) (Time $h new_moon)) (And (Member (sk_keep $h) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $h) $sb) (Theme (sk_keep $h) potency) (Still (sk_keep $h)) (During (sk_keep $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The possessive "its potency" is silently dropped: the Theme is the bare kind `potency` with no possessed witness and no `Possession` link back to $sb, so the stated possessor relation is lost.

`(Still (sk_keep $h))` is unlicensed here — the sentence contains no "still"/continuative marker, and the maintenance-verb `Still` of the resultative rule attaches to a reified result state in the "keep NP ADJ" shape, which this parse (keep + NP object, no secondary predicate) never builds.
The minted compound time symbol `new_moon` carries no decomposition atom `(Inheritance new_moon moon)`, unlike the parallel minted compound condition `room_temperature` in the instruction set.

review.notes: The whenever-rule frame, the `salt_bloom` genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed, the rebinding of "that salt-bloom" to the premise variable, and the rule TV are all correct; the defects are confined to the consequent's encoding of "keeps its potency".

issues.reason: 'its potency' is a possessive-pronoun genitive whose stated possessor may never be silently dropped (Possessive / genitive NP; Core patterns: a stated restriction is never silently dropped), so the bare-kind Theme potency with no possessed witness and no (Possession <possessed> $sb) widens the claim.

(Still ...) is licensed only by the surface particle 'still' (Aspectual particles) or on the reified state witness of the maintenance 'keep NP ADJ' resultative shape, and this clause — keep with a plain NP object, a listed Theme verb — has neither, so the atom fails the point-at-the-words test.

A compound calendar-period name used as a bare time constant follows the stated precedent ('a fiscal / calendar period is a term when the year is stated — (Quarter 3 2003) — else the bare constant (first_quarter)'), and time-slot constants are not kinds owing decomposition; the room_temperature mandate is specific to ConditionalProperty condition slots.

adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form mints the possessed witness in the conclusion — (Theme (sk_keep $h) (sk_potency $h)) (Member (sk_potency $h) potency) (Possession (sk_potency $h) $sb); issue 1's compliant form simply omits the Still atom, leaving the keep event with its class, Agent $sb, Theme and During $h.
adjudication.notes: The whenever frame itself is correct — trigger in the premises, response Skolemized on the occurrence $h with the During tie, 1.0/0.9 TV — and 'that salt-bloom' rightly rebinds to $sb.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the new moon, that salt-bloom stays potent.
parse: (: whenever_gather_potent (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $e gather) (Agent $e $k) (Theme $e $sb) (Member $sb salt_bloom) (Time $e new_moon)) (And (Member (sk_potent $sb) potent) (Experiencer (sk_potent $sb) $sb) (Still (sk_potent $sb)) (Member $sb potent) (During (sk_potent $sb) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: whether a multi-word named time constant ("the new moon" -> new_moon) takes Compound-concepts decomposition (a genus atom) or stays an opaque bare Time symbol -- the Time section only bars a witness/Member atom for a named time and is silent on a genus, while ConditionalProperty does decompose compound condition symbols (room_temperature -> temperature)
review.notes: The "stays potent" continuation copular is encoded exactly as specified (reified state + Experiencer + Still + flat atom, no Result, no matrix event), and "that salt-bloom" correctly binds the premise variable rather than minting a witness.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the full moon, that salt-bloom turns to chalky residue.
parse: (: keeper_gather_turn (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $g gather) (Agent $g $k) (Theme $g $s) (Member $s salt_bloom) (Time $g full_moon)) (And (Member (sk_turn $s) turn) (Patient (sk_turn $s) $s) (Member (sk_residue $s) chalky_residue) (Experiencer (sk_residue $s) $s) (Member $s chalky_residue) (Result (sk_turn $s) (sk_residue $s)) (During (sk_turn $s) $g))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's Skolem terms (sk_turn $s) and (sk_residue $s) are keyed only to the theme $s, not to the trigger occurrence $g, so two gatherings of the same salt-bloom would collapse onto one turn event (also making it During two triggers) — the instruction set makes a dependent existential a function of every universal that scopes over it, and its whenever template keys the consequent on the trigger event variable.

q2_gaps: "at the full moon" — a definite NP naming a recurring natural/astronomical phase used as a temporal adjunct: the Time section supplies structured calendar/clock terms, speech-anchored deictic constants, and day-part constants (morning/dawn/noon/dusk/night), but nothing covering this, and it does not say whether such a symbol is a bare Time constant (as the parse takes it) or an ordinary event-noun entity like "the storm", nor whether a compound time symbol owes decomposition atoms the way room_temperature does
review.notes: The change-of-kind result is encoded exactly as the instruction set's turn-into pattern (subject as Patient, result state reified on the same subject via Experiencer, flat copular atom, Result link, no spatial Goal), and the "that salt-bloom" anaphor correctly binds the premise variable. Fusing chalky_residue rather than splitting the descriptive adjective is borderline against the incidental-description bar, but both decomposition atoms are emitted so the two readings are information-equivalent.

issues.reason: The instruction set makes each dependent existential a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it, and its whenever template keys the response event on the trigger occurrence ((sk_bark $x), During $x), so (sk_turn $s)/(sk_residue $s) keyed only to the theme would merge the turn events — and their During links — of two gatherings of the same salt-bloom.

gaps_confirmed: 'at the full moon' — a recurring lunar-phase temporal adjunct fits no Time category (calendar/clock terms, deictic constants, day-parts), and the instruction set does not say whether it is a bare Time constant or an event-noun entity, nor whether such a compound time symbol owes decomposition atoms
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is the same whenever-rule with the consequent Skolem terms keyed to the trigger occurrence and every premise universal — e.g. (sk_turn $k $g $s) and (sk_residue $k $g $s) — with the During link tying (sk_turn $k $g $s) to $g.
adjudication.notes: The turn-to result shape (Patient subject, reified state with Experiencer, flat copular atom, Result link), the donkey-anaphora binding of 'that salt-bloom' to the premise variable, and the (Time $g full_moon) improvisation are otherwise licensed or acceptable in gap territory.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper gathers salt-bloom at the half moon, that salt-bloom turns to chalky residue.
parse: (: keeper_gather_turn (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $g gather) (Agent $g $k) (Theme $g $b) (Member $b salt_bloom) (Time $g half_moon)) (And (Member (sk_turn $b) turn) (Patient (sk_turn $b) $b) (Member (sk_residue $b) residue) (Member (sk_residue $b) chalky) (Experiencer (sk_residue $b) $b) (Member $b residue) (Member $b chalky) (Result (sk_turn $b) (sk_residue $b)) (During (sk_turn $b) $g))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a recurring natural-cycle time expression under a definite article ('at the half moon') — the Time section enumerates calendar/clock structured terms, deictic constants, day-parts and fiscal periods, so it is unstated whether this is a bare Time symbol (as parsed), a structured term, or an ordinary definite NP taking a witness and a kind atom, and whether the compound symbol takes a genus atom

a two-part result predicate (noun + adjective, 'chalky residue') in the change-of-kind State-result shape — the doctrine reifies one state witness carrying one Member atom and does not say whether both atoms ride one state witness or two
review.notes: Routing (bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants to the occurrence rule), the donkey-style binding of 'that salt-bloom' to the premise variable, the change-of-kind shape on the subject's own symbol with no separate entity and no spatial Goal, and the flat dual-emit are all correct. One deviation worth noting: the response event is keyed as (sk_turn $b) on the theme rather than on the trigger occurrence $g, so it is one event per bloom rather than per occurrence, though During still ties it to $g.
